title: Collatz: Hardy inverse-tree spectrum and direct closing attempts
body:
## Current checkpoint — 23 November 2026

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** Four high-variance attacks pursued the full basin, unrestricted cycles and ordinary escape. The principal unconditional result is a complete infinite-dimensional theorem for the actual Collatz operator. The arithmetic core is checked in Lean; the infinite analysis is a written, internally reconstructed proof.

**Published head:** [8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f)

## 1. A disk of infinite-multiplicity Hardy eigenvalues

For the actual shortcut map T, let the coefficient pushforward be

    T_operator(sum c_n z^n) = sum c_n z^(T(n)).

On unweighted H²(D), the new written proof establishes:

    Every |lambda| < 2^(1/16) is an eigenvalue of infinite multiplicity.

Two increasing odd unit predecessors with exponents in 3,...,8 give an injective binary tree. The exact shared even-tail coefficients have a convergent square-norm bound. Two incoming channels have the same defect lambda*z^n, which cancels on subtraction. An antichain supplies infinitely many disjoint supports. All these modes can be generated inside the known basin of 1.

Consequently I−T_operator is not Fredholm on unweighted H² and its index cannot give a finite cycle count. Switching to unweighted coefficient ell¹ does not repair Fredholmness: the fixed vectors are cycle-supported, but explicit dyadic chain averages have distance one from that kernel and residual norm 2/N, proving nonclosed range.

The signed modes do not classify positive cycles. The note separately proves that nonnegative ell² fixed vectors are supported on actual cycles, preserving that distinction. The comparison with Neklyudov and Béhani concerns their exact operators and displayed function spaces; no exhaustive novelty claim is made.

[Complete Hardy proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/HARDY_INVERSE_TREE.md) · [Universal branching theorem in Lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/InverseBranching.lean) · [Exact finite flow controls](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/check_hardy_flows.py)

## 2. Same-source total variation and the attempted entropy closure

For the actual rooted trace law along a stipulated escaping orbit, retain the exact radial variable

    (q_j − B_infinity)/(q_j Lambda_j).

Its laws nu_j satisfy

    nu_infinity >= (D_infinity/D_j) nu_j,
    TV(nu_j,nu_infinity) <= 1 − D_infinity/D_j -> 0.

This permits arbitrary moving bounded tests and preserves a positive original-source submeasure. The inherited canonical analytic inputs remain source-qualified.

**Concurrent overlap is explicitly credited.** PR180 advanced during this work to 04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2. Its stronger common-path conditioning theorem covers this convergence: our normalized variable is exactly its Z/p. We do not present the independently derived TV argument as a unique priority result.

The distinct closing test keeps the ordinary source when passing to the compact solenoid. Even granting conditional Haar mixing, the root-retaining joint limit is Haar times the original time law. The quotient sees V=q−floor(B_infinity), while the root is Q=V+L. The exact entropy subtraction H(Q)>=H(V)−H(L|Q), with H(L|Q)>=H(V|J), shows that conditional mixing pays its full entropy through the integer part. This does not supply the missing ordinary endpoint entropy.

[Exact TV proof and entropy accounting](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/RENORMALIZED_FIBRE_ENTROPY_ATTACK.md)

## 3. Other direct closing attacks and exact outcomes

- **Full-basin Fourier rigidity:** a bounded symmetric Abel L¹ norm for the actual basin would permit Cohen's idempotent theorem and prove Collatz. That bound was not proved. Explicit anchored, dyadically invariant inputs lose finite Fourier-measure regularity under the actual positive-integer pullback, including after full odd acceleration. The note computes the nonreal fifth-root residue and the shortcut logarithmic norm coefficient. [Full argument](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/FOURIER_IDEMPOTENT_CLOSURE_ATTEMPT.md).
- **All-word cycle positivity:** the full polynomial retains the actual matching condition. Prime-valuation balance alone loses it: the actual paths 25→19→29→11 and 55→83→125 have equal endpoint products. No completely additive potential can strictly decrease on all five edges. The integer-valued theorem and exact numerator 581 / denominator 13 are Lean checked. [Proof and controls](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/ALL_WORD_POLYNOMIAL_ATTACK.md) · [Lean certificate](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/PrimeBalanceObstruction.lean).
- **All-scale ternary height barrier:** every finite positive pole correction fails on actual positive approximants. The attempted integrable ternary superharmonic construction has the wrong mean multiplier. Ordinary-only singular constructions and arbitrary envelope upper bounds are explicitly outside this exclusion. [Attempt and precise limits](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/TERNARY_POLE_BARRIER_ATTEMPT.md).

## 4. Five freshly advanced peer heads incorporated

The initial refresh covered all 145 PR metadata records. A second refresh found new science on PR178, PR176, PR185, PR180 and PR182; the actual new files were read at their exact heads.

PR185's new same-source collision theorem improves the central remaining target: an upper bound O(3^(−theta*m)) on the very same inverse endpoint laws, with m²=O(M), would now contradict its lower bound c*sqrt(m)*3^(−theta*m). That upper bound is still unproved. Our solenoid coordinate is not that endpoint.

PR178 reduces one branch-noncollapse question to tightness of a scalar first-digit log-odds, without proving the tightness. The new source-replacement and Mahler notes supply no universal merger or basin regularity.

Building on PR182's explicitly qualified high rational-cycle theorem, a new generic lift preserves prescribed word congruences, fixed Fourier tests and the minimum inequality, yet has completely disjoint actual source and image sets. Its full polynomial residual has exactly 2L nonzero coefficients. The ordered lifts are not integer orbits, and the restriction Q=2^r 3^s is retained.

[Exact latest-source crosswalk](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/LATE_FRONTIER_SYNTHESIS.md) · [New source-qualified lifting consequence](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk23/HIGH_CYCLE_FOURIER_LIFT.md) · [Five pinned new heads](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov23/risk23/late-frontier.json)

## 5. Actual verification and evidence boundary

- Two new Lean core/Std modules compiled. All **21 public theorems** were audited; only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. There is no admission, custom axiom, native proof shortcut or Mathlib dependency.
- Three new finite controls passed: actual Hardy flow coefficients and leaf defects; prime-balance/full-word/rational-lift arithmetic; and the Fourier interface formulas. Floating sanity checks are labeled separately.
- The complete Hardy disk proof and the TV/entropy proof received independent collaborating-agent reconstructions. The final hashes and review boundaries distinguish earlier reviewed drafts, subsequent endpoint arguments and concurrent-source credit.
- No previous project Lean modules or large peer enumerations were rebuilt.
- On the **exact fetched publication commit above**, all five required repository gate commands passed in a clean, complete **540-file checkout**. All 22 manifest-listed files and the five compiled/control source hashes matched. The checkout remained clean.

[New source execution receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov23/risk23/new-source-checks.json) · [Exact written review bindings](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8870528daa6a13cc941d602e578e35c8bfa4bf4f/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov23/risk23/review-scope.json)

Repository integrity does not prove the analytic claims or Collatz. Full universal descent, escape exclusion and nontrivial-cycle exclusion remain open.
